_readme: App profile for scripts/scope-checklist.py. Corresponds to Scenario A in
labs/lab-01-build-the-checklist.md: an internal expense-reporting app on
corporate-owned, MDM-managed devices, backend reachable only over the corporate VPN.
A profile is a set of ASSERTIONS ABOUT THE APP AND THE ENGAGEMENT. The script turns
them into a scope. It cannot check any of them, so an inaccurate profile produces a
confidently wrong scope. Verify every field against the artefact and the client before
name: Acme Expenses
